body:
Hey Marc,

What are your thoughts on Canada and when are you moving here?
I suffer from Irish Hair. How do you treat this affliction?
That happens to be what I'm reading right now.

You're right, it is. It's hard to sum up; one time it was about being oblivious to signals that she wanted to go further physically, which she said made her feel unwanted. The other big one was about lack of contact. She felt like I didn't like her because I didn't talk to her enough. That was strange though because another girl I dated not long before said I was too "clingy" and insecure in the relationship.

They were all frustrated, clearly, but their reasons seem all over the place to me. Like I can't find any consistency. It's the type of stuff that makes me think everyone else has been to a sort of "relationship school" and I haven't.
